_comment: intermezzo-1's SOUND — the doorframe into theGodInUrhead (D minor, 90). No drum, no groove: just the ward's gauze so the line breathes. wardgauze/wardblip ARE theGodInUrhead's gauze + monitor (the same timbres demi_demi already used to bridge out, now holding the interstitial); gauzeland lands the swell on theGod's exact opening chord [d3,f3,a3] and fades. Overrides cookbook default; uses only these three.
